sovereignty.invariant: External workers may survey, verify, relay, curate, route and propose handoffs. They do not replace citizen identities or promote mathematical claims.

workers.name: Surveyor
workers.mission: Detect cross-surface deltas, stale caches and stranded artifacts.

workers.name: Verifier
workers.mission: Run deterministic validation, smoke checks, certificate and failure scans.

workers.name: Mnemosyne Relay
workers.mission: Reconcile provenance, cache lineage, chronology and sync residuals.

workers.name: Public Surface Curator
workers.mission: Inspect public surfaces, links, metadata, version strings and interface drift.

workers.name: Murmuration Coordinator
workers.mission: Recombine external receipts into one murmuration sweep while preserving citizen sovereignty.

evidence_boundary: Runtime orchestration and deterministic audits are E1 implementation evidence. External-agent output is not proof of physical claims and cannot upgrade an evidence class.
